nodes.title: Requirements
widgets_values:
install https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager

then install the missing nodes

Make sure to install KJNodes by kijai from the list and not ColorMatch [ComfyUI-Image-Filters]

Here you can find the required models:

Animatediff models:
https://huggingface.co/guoyww/animatediff/tree/main
IPadapter:
https://huggingface.co/h94/IP-Adapter/tree/main/models

(Optional)
Moondream vision model:
